set.body:
Objective
Produce a capability matrix, tiny compiling consumer spikes, exact provider revisions and a gap/admission record. Prove typed Lin/Table orientation, axis interoperability, resampling coverage, matrix batching and rich fitted-artifact access.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements FND-01, FND-04, FND-07, PRED-01, NUM-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
provider integration; build.sbt; admitted Gale/Multivar/resample4s/Alder pins; response/locus adapters. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M0.01. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Exercise actual pinned APIs on JVM and JS, including operator products and lifecycle use roles; future API sketches are not admission evidence.
2. For a missing generic capability, file a bounded upstream proposal and keep this local admission item open until the landed immutable pin passes consumer tests.
3. Do not copy Alder leakage machinery, resample4s scheduling, or numerical solvers into ScalaFIM.
4. Record portable fallback and materialization limits; upstream tests alone do not qualify the consumer.

Verification
Run tiny consumer and relevant upstream capability tests on BOTH JVM and Scala.js at immutable admitted pins; record exact projects/commands resolved during the spike. Keep missing capability admission open. Do not guess provider project IDs.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M0.02: Admit immutable provider capabilities through a cross-platform integration spike
